ITEM 1 | Breaded, golden-tan coating with crumbly, granular surface and visible browning, wrapped around a pale, moist interior; pieces are elongated strips about 6-7 cm long and 2-3 cm wide, clustered in the upper right quadrant of a white square plate, with loose crumbs scattered nearby | 95
ITEM 2 | Bright green, fibrous filling visible at the cut edge of the breaded strip near the center-right of the cluster, with a slightly glossy, moist sheen; a small strip about 3 cm long and 1 cm wide, partly enclosed by the coating | 8
ITEM 3 | Loose golden breadcrumb fragments scattered around the base of the cluster and across the plate surface, dry and crumbly, each piece a few millimeters across | 4
